basis: R1489 confirms SIMD format slowdown with fewer instructions but more generic branch misses, and AArch64 slowdown with unchanged instruction work and fewer misses. R1491 observes retired-branch and micro-operation counters plus sampling, but raw instruction-cache and instruction-TLB events remain all zero.
order: Rotate all four variants by cycle, then run forward and reverse, on one fixed inode/path/size with ASLR disabled and CPU affinity fixed.
scope: Diagnostic attribution with the unchanged frozen consumer and candidate sources. Sampled timing is not performance qualification, skid does not identify the exact responsible branch, and zero fetch counters cannot establish cache behavior.
